devdoc.details: Enter flow: tokenFrom -> USDS (via aggregator) -> sUSDS (native ERC4626 deposit).      Exit flow:  sUSDS -> USDS (native ERC4626 redeem) -> tokenOut (via aggregator).      sUSDS is a standard ERC4626 vault whose underlying asset is USDS.
